title: Figure Skater Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating conservation of angular momentum through a figure skater spin. Control arm position to observe how moment of inertia changes affect angular velocity while angular momentum remains constant.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: angular momentum
rotation
physics
conservation laws
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of figure skater angular momentum conservation
Explore figure skater angular momentum conservation through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of figure skater angular momentum conservation to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on figure skater angular momentum conservation
